careers.description: General Physician / MBBS Doctor? An MBBS Doctor / General Physician diagnoses and treats a wide spectrum of acute and chronic illnesses — from fever and infections to diabetes and hypertension. They serve as the first point of contact in healthcare, triaging patients, ordering investigations, prescribing treatment, and making referrals. They sit at the intersection of biology, pharmacology, psychology, and social science.

careers.description: Psychiatrist / Mental Health Doctor? A Psychiatrist is a medical doctor who specialises in the diagnosis, treatment, and prevention of mental health disorders — including depression, anxiety, bipolar disorder, schizophrenia, OCD, PTSD, and addiction. They uniquely combine neurobiology (brain chemistry, neuroimaging) with psychotherapeutic techniques to treat the whole person. Unlike psychologists, psychiatrists can prescribe medication.

careers.description: Geriatrician (Elder Care Specialist)? A Geriatrician is a physician specialising in the health and disease of older adults — typically those above 65 years. Unlike regular physicians who treat a single system, geriatricians manage complex multi-morbidity (5-10 simultaneous conditions), polypharmacy (10+ medications), and the unique syndromes of ageing — falls, frailty, dementia, delirium, and end-of-life care. It is one of India's most urgently needed and least understood medical specialities.

careers.description: Cardiac Electrophysiologist? A Cardiac Electrophysiologist (EP) is a cardiologist who sub-specialises in diagnosing and treating heart rhythm disorders (arrhythmias) — from atrial fibrillation to life-threatening ventricular arrhythmias. Using sophisticated 3D cardiac mapping systems and catheter-based procedures, they perform ablation procedures to cure arrhythmias and implant devices like pacemakers and defibrillators, representing one of cardiology's most technically advanced and highly trained sub-specialities.
